body.x: [CES 2019] COBL Showcases COBL, a Block-based Coding Block
COBL has displayed its coding block COBL in CES 2019, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 to 11.

COBL is an abbreviation of coding-block and this block-base coding product enables the direct programming for users. Also, it is a comprehensive teachware of SW window that has the most basic sensor, I/O controller, robotic, and learning loT.

Its characterized features are universally used Scratch 2.0, App Inventor for Android, IOT, and other various software. Since it is made as Duplo blocks, the scale of expandability is greater than other competing products.
